hooks.command: bash -c 'input=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".file_path // empty" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "(\.env(\..*)?$|package-lock\.json$|pnpm-lock\.yaml$|\.lock$)"; then echo "[BLOCKED] Sensitive file detected. Modifications to .env files and lock files should be done manually."; exit 2; fi'

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then REAL_FILE=$(realpath "$FILE" 2>/dev/null); REAL_DIR=$(realpath "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null); CONTAINED=0; if [ -n "$REAL_FILE" ] && [ -n "$REAL_DIR" ]; then case "$REAL_FILE" in "$REAL_DIR"/*) CONTAINED=1 ;; esac; fi; if [ "$CONTAINED" = 1 ]; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && pnpm exec biome check --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; pnpm exec prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi; fi; true
